# Zachary Schallenberger

## Professional summary

Zachary is a software engineer at Ford Motor Company. His experience also includes co-founding Freats, LLC; software development at Tyler Technologies; undergraduate research funded by the National Science Foundation and the U.S. Department of Defense; and internships at BMW Manufacturing.

He earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Montana State University and is pursuing a Master of Business Administration at the University of Michigan-Dearborn.

## Topics

- Full-stack software engineering
- React, JavaScript, Node.js, HTML, CSS, Git, and Docker
- Automotive technology and customer experiences
- Product design, usability testing, and agile development
- Electronic music production under the artist name Zapps
